## Patch set 2 pushed to 3264 (`e5b4770043a`) — all 4 findings addressed, verify green

`make verify` RC=0 on this tree: 20489 passed / 27 skipped (default tier, 1:13:37), 203 passed
/ 3 skipped (integration tier, 7:15). 0 FAILED or ERROR lines.

**Blocking finding was correct, and wider than it stated.** It cited `ticket_id`, `status` and
`state` as keys retrieval never returns. I checked both producers rather than accepting the
claim: `lexical.search` (`src/rebar/similar/lexical.py:112-115`) and `embedding.rank`
(`src/rebar/similar/embedding.py:474-477`) each emit exactly `id`/`alias`/`title`/`score`. The
3-way status fallback could therefore only ever render the constant `?` — pure noise, and
hashed into every chunk's `context_digest`. The renderer now emits
`  - {ident} -- {title} (similarity {score})`. Identity falls back to `id`, not `alias`,
because the backends produce `alias` as `alias or ""`, which is falsy-but-present for an
alias-less ticket.

**Advisory 1's root cause sat one layer below the missing file.** `.rebar/prompts/*` is
gitignored at `.gitignore:34`, and every shipped project criterion is readmitted by its own `!`
line. A rubric added without that line is invisible to git, so `load_criteria` would have
raised `RegistryError` in every checkout except the author's. Patch set 2 adds the 48-line
rubric **and** the un-ignore line; `git add` succeeding without `-f` is the proof it ships.

**Advisory 2** — 5 tests appended (22 total): real row shape, `id` fallback on empty `alias`,
80-character title truncation, non-numeric score, and the empty-candidates case that must
render `""` rather than a bare heading. 2 were RED-proved against the old renderer.

**Advisory 3** — `docs/plan-review-gate.md` gains
`### A third project criterion: project.plan-overlap (on demand)` after the ADR 0113 paragraph.

**`Verified -1` on patch set 1 was a real break, not a flake.** The activation path left 19
tests across 5 modules failing because they monkeypatch `_project_criteria` with fixed-arity
lambdas — adding a parameter to it is a breaking change to a test seam. The drop moved to the
call site as `_drop_unrequested_overlap`, equivalent because `_keep` filters on id and
allowlist only.

Awaiting `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1` on patch set 2.
